definitions.explanation: Fixing or restoring something that is damaged or deteriorated, especially buildings, roads, and infrastructure.

examples.japanese: {道路|どうろ}の{補修|ほしゅう}{工事|こうじ}が{始|はじ}まった。
{屋根|やね}を{補修|ほしゅう}してもらった。
{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}した{校舎|こうしゃ}の{補修|ほしゅう}に{多額|たがく}の{費用|ひよう}がかかる。
examples.english: Repairing the aging school building will cost a large amount.

notes:
USAGE:
{補修|ほしゅう} refers to repairing things that have deteriorated over time, particularly structures and infrastructure. It implies restoring something to a functional state rather than replacing it entirely.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {補修|ほしゅう}{工事|こうじ} (repair work/construction)
- {補修|ほしゅう}{費用|ひよう} (repair costs)
- {道路|どうろ}の{補修|ほしゅう} (road repair)
- {補修|ほしゅう}する (to repair)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{修理|しゅうり} is a broader term for fixing broken items (appliances, machines). {補修|ほしゅう} focuses on maintaining or patching up structures and facilities. {修繕|しゅうぜん} is more formal and often used for building maintenance.
